title: Calendly Pricing: 2026 Plans and Hidden Costs Compared
summary: Calendly pricing tiers dictate your monthly software expenses based on team size and feature requirements. Use this breakdown to select the plan.
body_markdown:
## Calendly vs Top Competitors on Price and Performance


Calendly’s pricing structure remains the industry standard, but its competitors now offer similar monthly rates while including the very features Calendly locks behind its highest paywalls. You are no longer paying a premium for exclusive tools, but rather for the brand name itself.


### Monthly per-seat cost by provider


The cost of scheduling software scales differently depending on whether you prioritize individual flexibility or administrative control.


> You are no longer paying a premium for exclusive tools, but rather for the brand name itself.


Calendly charges a flat rate per user that increases as you unlock team-wide branding and advanced integrations. SavvyCal matches the mid-tier pricing of the market leader but includes multi-organizer links at no extra cost.


Acuity Scheduling uses a tiered model based on the total number of calendars rather than individual logins.


This favors businesses with many employees but few distinct booking pages. Google Calendar bundles basic booking pages into existing productivity suites, which removes the need for a separate software line item for small teams.


### SavvyCal: Better UI for the same price point


By allowing the person booking the meeting to overlay their own calendar directly onto your availability, SavvyCal prevents the tab-switching fatigue that leads to abandoned bookings.


This matters because it has a more intuitive interface for both the sender and the recipient and costs close to Calendly’s Teams tier.


Calendly requires an upgrade for basic logic. SavvyCal includes features like ranked availability as a standard part of their core offering, which allows you to tell the system to prefer your morning slots over your afternoons.


### Acuity Scheduling pricing for service businesses


Acuity Scheduling focuses on the administrative needs of businesses that exchange money for time, such as salons or clinics.


It includes built-in intake forms and payment processing in its entry-level tiers. A business owner can collect client information and deposits in a single step rather than hacking together three different apps.


This section of the market values the "all-in-one" workflow over the sleek, minimal design favored by tech consultants.


AI assistants often manage these workflows to handle data entry. For example, a developer might use GPT-6 Astra to write the custom logic that syncs Acuity appointments with a private patient database. This keeps sensitive records updated the moment a user fills a slot.


### Google Calendar: The 'free' alternative for Workspace users


Google Calendar now includes "Appointment Slots" for any business using their office suite.


This provides a zero-cost alternative for teams that only need the basics. Because this is built into the email system you already use, there is no extra security review or billing setup required to start taking bookings.


This setup is ideal for high-volume, low-complexity tasks. You could use Gemini 3.8 Flash to scan your incoming emails.


The AI can automatically suggest the best Google Calendar booking link to a lead, which speeds up your response time without adding a single dollar to your software budget. Using the tools you already own avoids the "feature tax" entirely.
